title: SASSover50 - Dating, Sex, and Single Life...over 50
author: SASSover50
description: SASSover50 (Sexy And Single Sisters Over 50)*** SUBSCRIBE NOW- so you are notified as soon as the next episode drops- We're Sexy and Single Sisters talking about life and dating in our later years during the 21st century! Divorced, unmarried, widowed, or otherwise unattached, during your PRIME years? We're here for you! This is REAL talk, NOT scripted! (Warning: We can be a little X-Rated at times.) Whether you're in your 40s, 50s, 60s, or ANY age (our audience is expansive), we're sharing OUR dating experiences, dating advice, and dating tips while navigating dating apps, red flags, sex, and more. We want to give all of our listeners insight and remind you that you're not alone! Come join your new girlfriends, some of our featured listeners, and even some Sexy and Single Misters while we dive into life and the reality of being single midlife.
